purpose: Held-out validation corpus for ACR v0.2 rules; none of these issues was used in the v0.2 rule-design round (realworld pilot 2026-10-17).
source: GitHub issue search across langchain-ai/langgraph (mostly) and langchain-ai/langchain
selection_note: Candidates are real, reproducible issue reports (no PRs, no pure feature requests, no screenshot-only reports); each has a fenced code block in the issue body and local raw body + comments snapshots. Priority: user graph/composition failures > complete code > explicit error > maintainer confirmation; framework-internal bugs are included but tagged source_type_guess=framework. recommended_rank is set for the top 20 only.

candidates.title: map-reduce InvalideUpdateError
candidates.selection_reason: Classic map-reduce fan-out/fan-in graph; a list-valued state field turns into str and raises InvalidUpdateError - direct ACR002-style parallel write conflict.

candidates.title: Sink node issue, if multiple subgraphs are used in parallel
candidates.selection_reason: Multiple subgraphs run in parallel into a sink node; replacing subgraphs with plain nodes makes it work - subgraph output boundary / shared-state case (ACR001/ACR003).

candidates.title: Fan-out/in fails with subgraphs
candidates.selection_reason: Send-based fan-out into subgraphs then merge back into the parent state fails; works when the fan-out targets a parent function - subgraph state merge/output-schema case.

candidates.title: Subgraphs channels reducer updating out of turn
candidates.selection_reason: Two sibling subgraphs share the parent state key behind a counting reducer; reducer fires out of turn across supersteps - parallel subgraph reducer semantics (ACR001/ACR002).

candidates.title: langgraph.errors.InvalidUpdateError: Invalid update for channel medical with values
candidates.selection_reason: Concrete InvalidUpdateError for a channel written twice in one step, with graph code; maintainer (sydney-runkle) replied.

candidates.title: langgraph.errors.InvalidUpdateError: Can receive only one value per step. Use an Annotated key to handle multiple values. error when running retry in graph parallel processing
candidates.selection_reason: Parallel branches plus a conditional retry edge on one branch produce 'Can receive only one value per step' - parallel + retry composition (ACR002/ACR005-adjacent).

candidates.title: langgraph.errors.InvalidUpdateError: Must write to at least one of ['input', 'plan', 'past_steps', 'response']
candidates.selection_reason: Long plan-and-execute thread; a node returns no declared keys and raises InvalidUpdateError 'Must write to at least one of ...' - state schema / node return contract (ACR007-adjacent).

candidates.title: Subgraph with private state doesn't have a proper state at the last node
candidates.selection_reason: Double-nested subgraphs with private state; the innermost graph's last node returns parent-private keys and errors - private state / nested output schema composition.

candidates.title: PrivateState not working if the node is activated by a Send object
candidates.selection_reason: PrivateState stops working when the node is activated by Send - Send + private schema interaction.

candidates.title: Default value of state variable not working with reducer function
candidates.selection_reason: Default value on an Annotated reducer field is not applied - reducer/default initialization semantics; maintainer (sydney-runkle) replied.

candidates.title: Update state fails when resuming subgraph after interrupt
candidates.selection_reason: State update/persistence behavior when resuming a subgraph after interrupt - subgraph resume + state update ordering.

candidates.title: Remote Subgraph (using interrupt) not resuming
candidates.selection_reason: RemoteGraph subgraph containing interrupt does not resume after Command(resume=...); self-contained repro with langgraph dev.

candidates.title: 【Command】：Can't use update and List[Send] at the same time if graph==Command.PARENT
candidates.selection_reason: Combining Command(update=...) with a list of Send under Command.PARENT - routing/update composition; maintainer (sydney-runkle) replied.

candidates.title: LangChain messages casted to BaseMessage when passed to subgraph via Send arg
candidates.selection_reason: LangChain message objects passed to a subgraph via Send arg are cast to BaseMessage, breaking the child node's type expectation.

candidates.title: Passing private state with Class Node
candidates.selection_reason: Private state used with a class-based node fails with 'must write to global state' while the documented function-node version works - node declaration/output contract (ACR007-adjacent).

candidates.title: Receiving multiple inputs on a single node not working in a vanilla state
candidates.selection_reason: Plain-dict state with parallel branches triggers LastValue/InvalidUpdateError; adding an Annotated reducer fixes it - minimal ACR002 baseline.

candidates.title: if there are two nodes（one node has a prenode） go to same one 4th node , then that 4th node will run twice
candidates.selection_reason: Diamond join where one input has a predecessor makes the shared 4th node run twice - fan-in / superstep execution semantics.

candidates.title: Subgraph state is not inserted to persistance db.
candidates.selection_reason: Subgraph state is not persisted to the checkpointer DB as expected; multi-graph persistence expectation with Postgres saver.

candidates.title: No way to declare the subgraphs a node invokes; detection cannot see them
candidates.selection_reason: find_subgraph_pregel cannot see dynamically selected subgraphs; issue asks for an explicit subgraph declaration - directly relevant to ACR's static subgraph reachability limits.

candidates.title: InvalidUpdateError raised in graph.astream() when given a list of HumanMessage
candidates.selection_reason: astream() with a list of HumanMessage raises InvalidUpdateError: Expected dict - input/state shape contract.

candidates.title: Invalid state saved to checkpoint without validation, causing permanent corruption.
candidates.selection_reason: Node returns a value violating its Pydantic state schema; checkpoint is written but can never be read back - output validation gap.

candidates.title: Graph silently converts output to Dict even though it should be Pydantic class
candidates.selection_reason: Pydantic state output is silently converted to dict at the graph boundary - output schema contract; maintainer (sydney-runkle) replied.

candidates.title: Lang Graph did not save all data to the checkpoint
candidates.selection_reason: Custom Redis/Postgres checkpointer appears to persist only fields written by the final node - partial state persistence/merge expectation.

candidates.title: apparent caching issue w/ subgraphs
candidates.selection_reason: Maintainer-filed minimal repro: caching does not interact correctly with subgraphs - cache identity vs subgraph invocation (ACR004/ACR008-adjacent).

candidates.title: default_cache_key collides distinct inputs that share tobytes() (numpy dtype / PIL palette) when passed as keyword args
candidates.selection_reason: default_cache_key collides distinct numpy/PIL inputs sharing tobytes() - task cache identity/serialization (ACR008-adjacent).

candidates.title: ToolNode silently drops Command.update when a tool returns Command(graph=PARENT, goto=[Send(...)])
candidates.selection_reason: ToolNode / create_agent silently drops Command(update=..., graph=PARENT, goto=[Send(...)]) from one of two tools - Command+Send composition.

candidates.title: update_state during interrupt() clears StateSnapshot.interrupts and breaks resume-by-id
candidates.selection_reason: update_state during interrupt() clears StateSnapshot.interrupts and breaks resume-by-id - interrupt/update_state composition.

candidates.title: Headless tool results dropped when the resume is sent immediately after the interrupt
candidates.selection_reason: Headless client-side tool results are dropped when the resume arrives immediately after the interrupt - resume race loses child task writes.

candidates.title: [BUG] Resuming after a tool error re-runs the tool node, repeating a side effect that already happened
candidates.selection_reason: Resume after a failed tool re-runs the tool node and repeats an already-committed side effect - retry/resume with non-idempotent side effect (ACR005-adjacent).

candidates.title: add_messages skips merging, deletion and format= for messages after RemoveMessage(id=REMOVE_ALL_MESSAGES)
candidates.selection_reason: add_messages short-circuits after RemoveMessage(REMOVE_ALL), skipping merge/deletion/format semantics for following messages - messages reducer.

candidates.title: StateGraph._is_field_binop rejects valid reducers like set.union, functions with default args, and variadics`
candidates.selection_reason: StateGraph._is_field_binop rejects valid reducers such as set.union or functions with default args - reducer declaration/validation.

candidates.title: `bug: Send.__hash__ raises TypeError: unhashable type: 'dict' on standard dictionary payloads`
candidates.selection_reason: Send.__hash__ raises TypeError on dict payloads, breaking set-based fan-out deduplication - Send composition.

candidates.title: Bug Report: `create_agent` Doesn't Persist `None` Values in Command Updates
candidates.selection_reason: create_agent drops None values from Command state updates instead of applying custom reducers (langchain repo) - Command update semantics.
